title: Airtel Prepaid · recharge history and receipt
section: Prepaid FAQ · transaction history and receipt
content: Airtel says recent prepaid recharge transactions can be reviewed in the Airtel Thanks app. On airtel.in, sign in, open the account menu, and choose transaction history. A receipt can be opened from Help, then transaction history, by selecting the recharge and choosing Download Receipt. The page says a successful recharge cannot be cancelled. For a recharge not visible or a number-specific issue, verify the transaction in the signed-in account and contact Airtel through its official app or website. Do not promise a refund or plan change without checking the current transaction status and applicable guidance. Source checked for this demo on 2026-10-23; the source page does not state a publication date.
